nameEn: Manufacture of measuring, testing, navigating and control equipment
description: This class includes the manufacture of instruments and apparatus for measuring, testing, navigating and controlling.
includes: manufacture of automotive emissions testing equipment
manufacture of physical, chemical properties testing and measuring apparatus
manufacture of equipment for measuring temperature, humidity, pressure, radiation etc.
manufacture of instruments for measuring or checking electrical quantities
manufacture of instruments for measuring or detecting ionising radiations
manufacture of scales, balances and weighing machines
manufacture of navigating instruments: compasses, sextants, navigating computers
manufacture of surveying instruments: theodolites, photogrammetric instruments, levels
manufacture of metering equipment: water meters, gas meters, electricity meters
manufacture of medical diagnostic imaging equipment: MRI, CT, ultrasound
manufacture of electro-diagnostic apparatus: ECG, EEG
excludes: manufacture of watches and clocks, see 2652
manufacture of spectacles and lenses, see 3250
